description: Create or update a budget configuration for an agent or the entire organization. Budgets enforce spending limits with configurable enforcement modes: "alert_only" (notify but don't block), "soft_block" (block with override), or "hard_block" (strict enforcement). Specify limits in dollars. Do NOT use just to change enforcement mode — use update_budget_mode for that.

agent_id.description: Agent to set budget for. Omit for org-wide budget.

enforcement_mode.description: How to enforce the budget when exceeded

warning_pct.description: Percentage of limit that triggers a warning (default: 80)

name: metrx_set_budget
title: Set Budget
